comparison: Same tests, protocol and initial table as A1 bispf-optimized-quintic-v1; only prior_update differs.
conclusion: Frozen table: 13 PASS / 18 FAIL of 49; loses ring16_acquisition (hq 0.61), mode_hold, ae_gan_hold and ring_extension vs learned; crashes trajectory/residual_student hosts. Lower mass TV but precision 0.03-0.05 on the native grids. See reports/prior-ablation-2026-10-25/README.md.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Freezing the particle table (same initial locations and capacity) loses sampled-latent passes that the learned BISPF default holds.
next_action: Stop; use as the matched control for a learned-offset-on-frozen-anchor structural idea.

study.competing_explanation: The generator alone does the warping; a frozen quasi-Gaussian table supplies the same coverage, so learning the prior adds nothing measurable on these gates.
